observations: body: the line numbers 5 to 35 stand in the right margin and the locators «p. 195.» (L6) and «p. 196.» (L27) in the left margin; in «p. 195.» the point after the number is printed small.
body L5, L13: the letters of the references (a) and (b) are bold italic.
body L1, L2: specks stand over the first e of «eadem» and under the i of the last syllable of «latitudine»; they are not accents.
body L24: a small curved speck stands over the m of «humiles»; it is not an accent.
body L26: the s of «gradus» at the end of the line is printed with a stroke through it, like $.
body L38: a speck stands over the second p of «opponitur»; it is not an accent.
body L25-L26: a slanting stroke stands in the left margin beside the lines; it is not a sign.

notes_left L1, L5: the kappa of «σωματικῶς» is printed in the curly form (ϰ). In «Ἀποῤῥέοντες» (L5) the breathings over the two rhos are printed too small and blotted to be told apart on the scan; the usual ῤῥ is written.
notes_right L3, L6: the kappas of «καὶ» (L3, L6) and of «ἀκούοντα» (L6) are printed in the curly form (ϰ).
body L3, L26: a speck stands under the s of «plagas» (L3), and another over the a of «ad» at the head of L26; they are not signs.
notes_right L5, L7: the second c of «clercq» is printed broken; a speck stands over the opening parenthesis before «Francof. I, 12»; it is not a sign.
source_authority: Controlling master page image. Embedded text is not the authority for a reading.
transcription_convention: Source line breaks, hyphenation, quotation signs and word-level type distinctions retained. L numbers count text-bearing lines.
review_responsibility: Transcribed by Claude from the page images; Greek, Arabic, numbers and signs read on enlarged images. Not reviewed by a person.
